basis_zh: 基于杨开忠新空间经济学「空间品质驱动创新增长」理论框架，结合方案目标设置
basis_en: Based on Yang Kaizhong's New Spatial Economics framework of 'spatial quality driving innovation growth', aligned with proposal objectives

categories.description_zh: AI产业规模、创新能力、生态系统相关指标
categories.description_en: Metrics for AI industry scale, innovation capacity, and ecosystem

metrics.source: 方案目标设定，基于海淀区2026年AI产业3500亿元基础上增量聚焦
metrics.source_en: Proposal target, based on incremental focus on Haidian District's 2026 AI industry base of 350 billion RMB
metrics.calculation_method_zh: 重点片区AI核心产业增加值汇总，按年均复合增长率15-20%推算
metrics.calculation_method_en: Sum of AI core industry value-added in key areas, projected at 15-20% CAGR

metrics.source: 方案目标设定，基于海淀现有AI人才基础和引进计划推算
metrics.source_en: Proposal target, based on Haidian's existing AI talent base and recruitment plans
metrics.calculation_method_zh: 核心区就业岗位中AI相关岗位占比推算，结合人才住房供给容量
metrics.calculation_method_en: Estimated from AI-related job share in core area employment, combined with talent housing supply capacity

metrics.source: 方案目标设定，对标中关村现有独角兽企业数量及增长率
metrics.source_en: Proposal target, benchmarked against Zhongguancun's existing unicorn count and growth rate
metrics.calculation_method_zh: 基于AI产业规模与企业密度关系，结合孵化加速体系产出效率估算
metrics.calculation_method_en: Estimated based on AI industry scale and enterprise density relationship, combined with incubation acceleration system output efficiency

metrics.source: 方案目标设定，基于学习型空间品质量化方法
metrics.source_en: Proposal target, based on learning-oriented spatial quality quantification method
metrics.calculation_method_zh: 创新交往空间密度×使用频率×活动转化率，按核心区范围估算
metrics.calculation_method_en: Innovation interaction space density × usage frequency × event conversion rate, estimated for core area

metrics.name_zh: 校企合作项目年增长率
metrics.name_en: Annual Growth Rate of University-Industry Collaboration Projects
metrics.source: 方案目标设定，基于产学研融合机制设计
metrics.source_en: Proposal target, based on industry-university-research integration mechanism design
metrics.calculation_method_zh: 基于高校开放度提升、联合实验室建设、技术转移中心运营等综合推算
metrics.calculation_method_en: Projected from university openness improvement, joint lab construction, and technology transfer center operations

categories.description_zh: 绿地空间、公共空间、品质生活相关指标
categories.description_en: Metrics for green space, public space, and quality of life

metrics.name_en: Per Capita Park Green Space Area
metrics.source: 方案目标设定，现代化人民城市标准
metrics.source_en: Proposal target, modern people-centered city standard
metrics.calculation_method_zh: 公园绿地总面积/规划常住人口，含遗址公园、城市公园、社区绿地
metrics.calculation_method_en: Total park green space area / planned resident population, including heritage park, urban parks, and community green space

metrics.name_zh: 公园绿地500米服务半径覆盖率
metrics.name_en: Park Green Space 500m Service Radius Coverage Rate
metrics.source: 方案目标设定，对标生态园林城市标准
metrics.source_en: Proposal target, benchmarked against eco-garden city standard
metrics.calculation_method_zh: 居住用地中公园绿地500米覆盖范围占比，基于GIS缓冲区分析
metrics.calculation_method_en: Proportion of residential land within 500m of park green space, based on GIS buffer analysis

metrics.source: 方案概念性估算，含公园绿地、广场、步行街等
metrics.source_en: Conceptual proposal estimate, including park green space, plazas, pedestrian streets, etc.
metrics.calculation_method_zh: 公共开放空间总面积/重点设计区域面积（不含道路用地）
metrics.calculation_method_en: Total public open space area / key design area area (excluding road land)

metrics.source: 方案目标设定，对标上海15分钟生活圈标准
metrics.source_en: Proposal target, benchmarked against Shanghai 15-minute living circle standard
metrics.calculation_method_zh: 步行15分钟可达基本公共服务设施的居住用地占比
metrics.calculation_method_en: Proportion of residential land with access to basic public services within 15-minute walk

metrics.source: 方案目标设定，基于海淀现状绿化基础提升
metrics.source_en: Proposal target, based on improvement from Haidian's current greening baseline
metrics.calculation_method_zh: 各类绿地垂直投影面积/建成区面积，含公共绿地、附属绿地、立体绿化
metrics.calculation_method_en: Vertical projection area of all green space / built-up area, including public green space, attached green space, and vertical greening

categories.description_zh: 绿色出行、步行友好、轨道覆盖相关指标
categories.description_en: Metrics for green travel, walkability, and transit coverage

metrics.source: 方案目标设定，对标国际先进城市
metrics.source_en: Proposal target, benchmarked against international advanced cities
metrics.calculation_method_zh: （公共交通+步行+自行车）出行量/总出行量
metrics.calculation_method_en: (Public transit + walking + cycling) trips / total trips

metrics.source: 方案概念性估算，基于步行系统设计标准
metrics.source_en: Conceptual proposal estimate, based on pedestrian system design standards
metrics.calculation_method_zh: 综合评价步行网络密度、林荫覆盖率、设施完善度、安全舒适度等维度
metrics.calculation_method_en: Comprehensive evaluation of pedestrian network density, tree canopy coverage, facility completeness, safety and comfort

metrics.source: 基于现状轨道交通线路和站点分布的概念性估算
metrics.source_en: Conceptual estimate based on existing rail transit lines and station distribution
metrics.calculation_method_zh: 重点片区内轨道站点500米覆盖的建设用地比例
metrics.calculation_method_en: Proportion of construction land within 500m of rail transit stations in key areas

metrics.source: 方案设计值，含对径主骑行道和支线
metrics.source_en: Proposal design value, including diameter main bike lanes and branch lanes
metrics.calculation_method_zh: 沿京张创新对径双侧自行车道+东西向联络支线长度
metrics.calculation_method_en: Length of bilateral bike lanes along the innovation diameter + east-west connector branch lanes

categories.description_zh: 碳排放、绿色建筑、可再生能源相关指标
categories.description_en: Metrics for carbon emissions, green buildings, and renewable energy

metrics.name_zh: 单位GDP碳排放强度下降率
metrics.name_en: Carbon Emission Intensity per GDP Reduction Rate
metrics.source: 方案目标设定，对标北京市双碳目标
metrics.source_en: Proposal target, benchmarked against Beijing's dual carbon goals
metrics.calculation_method_zh: （基期碳排放强度-目标期碳排放强度）/基期碳排放强度×100%
metrics.calculation_method_en: (Baseline carbon intensity - target carbon intensity) / baseline carbon intensity × 100%

metrics.name_zh: 新建建筑绿建三星比例
metrics.name_en: New Buildings with 3-Star Green Building Label Ratio
metrics.source: 方案目标设定，核心区高标准要求
metrics.source_en: Proposal target, high standard requirement for core area
metrics.calculation_method_zh: 达到绿建三星标准的新建建筑面积/新建建筑总面积（核心区）
metrics.calculation_method_en: New building area meeting 3-star green building standard / total new building area (core area)

metrics.source: 方案目标设定，基于光伏+地源热泵+储能系统
metrics.source_en: Proposal target, based on PV + ground source heat pump + energy storage system
metrics.calculation_method_zh: 可再生能源供应量/总能源消费量（核心区建筑用能）
metrics.calculation_method_en: Renewable energy supply / total energy consumption (core area building energy use)

metrics.source: 海绵城市建设目标，对标北京海绵城市标准
metrics.source_en: Sponge city construction target, benchmarked against Beijing sponge city standard
metrics.calculation_method_zh: 通过海绵设施控制的年降雨量占总降雨量的比例
metrics.calculation_method_en: Proportion of annual rainfall controlled by sponge facilities to total rainfall

categories.description_zh: 文化设施、活动、吸引力相关指标
categories.description_en: Metrics for cultural facilities, activities, and attractiveness

metrics.source: 方案概念性估算，含博物馆、展亭、书店、活动空间等
metrics.source_en: Conceptual proposal estimate, including museums, pavilions, bookstores, event spaces, etc.
metrics.calculation_method_zh: 各类文化设施数量/重点设计区域面积
metrics.calculation_method_en: Number of cultural facilities / key design area

metrics.source: 方案目标设定，含节庆、市集、展览、论坛等
metrics.source_en: Proposal target, including festivals, markets, exhibitions, forums, etc.
metrics.calculation_method_zh: 品牌节庆活动+常态化活动+临时活动场次总和
metrics.calculation_method_en: Sum of brand festival events + regular events + temporary events

metrics.source: 方案目标设定，对标北京同类文化科技地标
metrics.source_en: Proposal target, benchmarked against similar cultural-tech landmarks in Beijing
metrics.calculation_method_zh: 遗址公园日常访客+文化活动参与+游客参观人次总和
metrics.calculation_method_en: Sum of heritage park daily visitors + cultural event participants + tourist visits

metrics.source: 方案概念性规划，沿遗址公园分布
metrics.source_en: Conceptual proposal planning, distributed along the heritage park
metrics.calculation_method_zh: 雕塑、装置艺术、环境艺术等永久性公共艺术作品
metrics.calculation_method_en: Permanent public artworks including sculptures, installation art, environmental art

categories.description_zh: 人才住房、公共服务、创新生活相关指标
categories.description_en: Metrics for talent housing, public services, and innovation lifestyle

metrics.source: 方案概念性估算，基于重点片区开发容量
metrics.source_en: Conceptual proposal estimate, based on key area development capacity
metrics.calculation_method_zh: 各类型人才住房套数汇总（公寓+共享公寓+家庭型+高端）
metrics.calculation_method_en: Sum of various talent housing types (apartments + co-living + family + high-end)

metrics.source: 方案目标设定，基于海淀现状基础提升
metrics.source_en: Proposal target, based on improvement from Haidian's current baseline
metrics.calculation_method_zh: 大专及以上学历就业人口/总就业人口（核心区口径）
metrics.calculation_method_en: Employed population with college degree or above / total employed population (core area scope)

metrics.source: 方案设计值，含咖啡、共享空间、路演厅等
metrics.source_en: Proposal design value, including cafés, co-working spaces, pitch halls, etc.
metrics.calculation_method_zh: 非正式创新交往空间数量/重点设计区域面积
metrics.calculation_method_en: Number of informal innovation interaction spaces / key design area
